wave0_verdict.verdict: C10-F007 CONFIRMED at wave-0 audit: effective role read verbatim from client X-Sentinel-Role header, no credential of any kind; P1 bounded by loopback default (P0-equivalent under --allow-remote).

fix.local_mode: Authorization: Bearer <token> — secrets.token_urlsafe(32), hmac.compare_digest, TTL rotation via api.token_ttl_seconds (file tokens only). Resolution: API_SENTINEL_TOKEN > --token-stdin > <workspace>/token (generated+printed once, 0600 best-effort — Windows chmod maps to read-only attribute, NTFS-ACL equivalence not claimed).
fix.integrated_mode:
X-Sentinel-Principal honored only with X-Sentinel-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256 over 'principal
role
workspace
timestamp
nonce' (API_SENTINEL_SHARED_SECRET / api.shared_secret / workspace token fallback). ±300 s skew, single-use nonce bounded by skew window, workspace-id equality, role validated against ROLE_SCOPES.
fix.in_process_seam: ApiContext(auth=None) keeps the Cycle-6 placeholder for direct TestClient injection ONLY; serve/create_app always resolve a real credential — verified by code path (_build_context -> resolve_auth; ensure_local_token never returns token=None) and by the live smoke below.
fix.failure_contract: 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="api-sentinel" + application/problem+json with details.reason (missing_credentials, bad_authorization_scheme, bad_token, token_expired, missing_*, bad_timestamp, stale_timestamp, bad_signature, replay, workspace_mismatch, unknown_role).
fix.scope_enforcement: ROLE_SCOPES viewer/analyst/operator/admin server-side; denial precedes resource lookup (no existence oracle); api.auth.denied + api.scope.denied audit rows best-effort, credential-free.
fix.cors: deny by default; api.cors_origins explicit opt-in; allow_credentials=False always.
